entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... uh, yes. I have this helmet I bought, and I think I need to return it. It's all very confusing.
I can certainly help you look into that. Do you have the order number available?
Oh, um, yes, I think so. It's... 77-5-B-X-91. I'm not sure if that's right. The website was a bit overwhelming.

No problem at all, let me pull that up for you... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Aura helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
A preference? I... I don't know. The color just isn't what I thought it would be from the pictures. It seems... off. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging; the box is unopened.
I see. So the color wasn't what you were expecting.

Yes, exactly. And you know, with something as important as a helmet, the safety is my top concern, and if the color is wrong, it just makes me feel uneasy about the whole thing. I just want to send it back. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered 71 days ago. One moment while I review our return policy.
Oh no, has it been too long? I've been so busy.
Not at all. According to our policy, you have 90 days to return an item. Since you're well within that timeframe and the item is in its original box, I can go ahead and approve this return for you.
Oh, really? That's a relief! Thank you so much. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

It's no trouble at all. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. You'll receive a full refund once we receive it back at our warehouse.
That's perfect. Thank you, Sarah. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
Have a wonderful day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
